_comment: The palette's colours (scripts/palette.py, load_file). name is the colour as the image model reads it (ink
is used as 'pure-<name>', so keep it one word); hex is drawn on the palette card and in the board's flow arrows.
Every colour must be darker (luminance, PIL "L") than the styles' module.json ink_threshold (200), or the
pipeline would not see it as ink; the board is always white. arrows: each flow arrow's colour is picked with
these weights (seeded per arrow; normalised to sum 1). label and description are the option text on the
label: Classroom
description: The classic four-marker whiteboard set: black, red, blue and green.

main.name: marker red
main._use: main accent: emphasis words, arrows, key highlights

second.name: marker blue
second._use: second accent: secondary objects and labels

third.name: marker green
third._use: third accent: small fills, ticks and light shading, least used
